subject: PAGE clause
notes: GR3 (cite.py --check 13.18.39.4 "If LAST CONTROL HEADING is omitted, integer-5 will be equal to integer-6" -> OK, 3) c)). DataBinder.Reports.cs:794-799 applies a) Heading=1, b) FirstDetail=Heading, c) LastControlHeading = LAST DETAIL if specified else FOOTING if specified else PageLimit, d) LastDetail = FOOTING if specified else PageLimit, e) Footing = LAST DETAIL if specified else PageLimit -- each exactly the spec's arm, and gated on Paged (GR3's 'If integer-1 is specified'). Run probes: gr3d.cob `PAGE LIMIT 10 LINES FOOTING 4.` + 6 x `LINE PLUS 1` details -> lines 1-4 then form feed then 2 lines (FIRST DETAIL defaulted to HEADING=1 per b), LAST DETAIL defaulted to FOOTING=4 per d)); gr3e.cob `HEADING 2 LAST DETAIL 3` -> PF relative LINE PLUS 1 printed on line 4 = FOOTING(defaulted to LAST DETAIL 3 per e))+1. c)'s 'specified' arm is unreachable only because LAST CONTROL HEADING has no surface (FMT/SR1 finding) -- the default computation itself is correct.
